test_nested_modules: test that pybind11 nested modules have correct __name__ attributes and submodule functions work
test_reference_internal: test that pybind11 classes can hold and assign internal references to other bound classes
test_importing: test that pybind11 modules can import and expose Python stdlib types like OrderedDict
test_pydoc: test that pydoc can generate documentation for pybind11 bound modules and their contents
test_duplicate_registration: test that registering two pybind11 objects with the same name returns an empty list
